4707.title: Pooled authentication and Chrome initialization
4707.rootCauseOneLine: BB preserves the pool auth-token override alongside the Chrome flag; downstream native-login suppression was not verified.
4707.proposedFix: First validate native-browser identity versus pooled transport authentication on an isolated macOS fixture; do not change auth globally without inference and remote-host coverage.
4707.caveats: Two clean runs confirm the BB options boundary and scoped bypass only. No native login, Chrome extension, real Claude CLI initialization, or pooled inference was exercised. The full probe is inline because the report repository prohibits separate scripts and logs.
